title: pm(post-stamped): the quoted stamp route accepts a FUTURE timestamp, so an estimated stamp is still spellable — shape is checked, direction in time is not
body:
`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` validates only the SHAPE of a `{{WAS:...}}` value, never its direction in
time, so a stamp that no act can have read — one in the future — passes the refusal set and is rendered
verbatim. That is the estimated stamp the tool exists to make unspellable, still spellable through the
one route the tool itself offers by name in its own refusal text.

## Contract text it violates

The script header, verbatim:

> Every timestamp a seat writes into a GitHub comment or body ... must come from a clock read by the
> same act that writes the text, never from the seat's sense of elapsed time.

and the quoted route's own declaration, verbatim:

> `{{WAS:2026-09-08T14:00Z}}`  a stamp that is a reading of something ELSE, declared as such and
> rendered verbatim.

and the refusal the shape check prints, verbatim:

> The quoted route renders a reading of something else VERBATIM, so its contents must be one
> `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` and nothing else — it is a declaration, not a free-text escape from the contract.

A future stamp is provably not a reading of anything, and the tool can say so for free — it already
holds the clock (`renderBody(text, nowMs)`), and it already compares the value against a shape.

## Repro (offline, no network), measured on `813f8e9f`

```
node --input-type=module -e "
import { stampRefusals, renderBody } from './scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs';
const NOW = Date.parse('2026-09-12T03:00Z');
const body = 'Verdict {{NOW}} — on the board read {{WAS:2099-01-01T00:00Z}}.';
console.log('refusals:', JSON.stringify(stampRefusals(body)));
console.log(renderBody(body, NOW).body);
"
```

Output:

```
refusals: []
Verdict 2026-09-12T03:00Z — on the board read 2099-01-01T00:00Z.
```

Zero refusals; the future stamp is written.

## Why the route is reachable rather than theoretical

The POSITIONAL refusal hands the seat the escape with the typed stamp already filled in — its text is
"Write `{{NOW}}` there, or `{{WAS:THE-TYPED-STAMP}}` if it is genuinely a reading of something else." A
seat whose sense of elapsed time is running ahead types its estimate, is refused positionally, and the
refusal's own second option accepts that same estimate unchanged. The recorded failures this tool was
built against were FORWARD-skewed (stamps up to ~30 minutes ahead of the clock), which is exactly the
half the shape check cannot see.

## Not a duplicate

`#17314` is the card that built the tool; it is closed. This is one spelling its refusal set does not
cover, not a restatement of the original defect.

## Out of scope for the PR that found it

Found while measuring `scripts/pm/**` for the dispatch of another card, whose deliverable is a charter
clause and touches no script. Filed rather than fixed there; no label, no assignee.
